counting_rule: Admit only evidence-reviewed textile cloth, yarn, nonwoven or source-confirmed textile fibre/application; one source/sample/treatment/washing state is counted once across TG conditions. Paper sheets and dispersed-fibre engineering plastics are excluded. Unknown scope is pending and uncounted.
admission_basis: Exact manual scope evidence, material/state/documentary hash and reviewed measurement fingerprint. Pending scope contributes zero to the target.
